note: Instrument calibration on ground-truth pendulum embeddings only (zoo states -> known maps). No trained-model latents were used.

controls.name: emb8_mild
controls.desc: random smooth embedding into R^8, mild

controls.name: emb8_medium
controls.desc: random smooth embedding into R^8, medium

controls.name: noise2
controls.desc: ref + isotropic noise, 2% of RMS radius

controls.name: helix
controls.desc: (cos, sin, omega, 2 cos omega, 2 sin omega): loop outside the top-3 PCs

controls.name: ring_ref
controls.desc: libration ring E in [-0.5, 0.5]: b1 = 1 but contractible in the cylinder (wrap 0)

controls.name: helix_thin
controls.desc: helix with the loop shrunk to 1/3

confirmation.repeats: 20..39 (fresh seeds, never used for fitting or selection)

arc_rot_glued.desc: glued for |omega| >= 1.5 (fast rotations), torn (a = 0.3) for |omega| <= 1, smooth in between

arc_rot_torn.desc: the reverse: torn for |omega| >= 1.5, glued for |omega| <= 1

none_libration.desc: libration only E <= 0.5: never reaches theta = pi

fit.rule: maximise min(TNR glued, TPR torn) on the calibration half of the core controls; geometric centre of the optimal plateau (grid 10^(k/100))

settings.statistic: min(R2 cos theta, R2 sin theta), kNN

fit.rule: 5th percentile of the theta-injective core controls, calibration half

run.note: ground-truth pendulum embeddings only; no trained-model latents

fold_rule.rule: folded if fold_index < t; maximise min(TPR folds, TNR core) on r < R/2; geometric centre of the optimal plateau

g_aniso_sin_1/10.desc: (cos, 0.1 sin, omega): glued, squeezed along the cut

run.note: ground-truth pendulum embeddings only; no trained-model latents
